main.summary: Object-facing persisted summary metadata describing how a `DataItem` is currently protected.
main.remarks:
This type stores stable summary information for inspection and orchestration while keeping transport-private envelope details outside the object model.
`DataProtectionInfo` is summary metadata only. It intentionally excludes wrapped key material, nonce material, recipient-table transport records, chunk framing details, and other envelope-private cryptographic state.
The persisted shape is organized as: Version, ProtectedAt, ProtectedByObjectId, ProtectedByThumbprint, Purpose, Recipients, Assertions, HasMultipleRecipients, and ProtectionMode.
The `Assertions` collection represents the active current-state assertions associated with the present protection state. It is not intended to store assertion history.

property.name: ProtectedAt
property.summary: Instant when the current protection state was created.

property.name: ProtectedByObjectId
property.summary: Optional object identifier of the actor that protected the current data state.

property.name: ProtectedByThumbprint
property.summary: Optional certificate thumbprint of the actor that protected the current data state.

property.name: Purpose
property.summary: Optional descriptive purpose metadata associated with the current protection state.

property.name: Recipients
property.summary: Recipient summaries for the current protection state.

property.name: Assertions
property.summary: Active assertion summaries associated with the current protection state.

property.name: HasMultipleRecipients
property.summary: True when the current protection state targets more than one recipient.

property.name: ProtectionMode
property.summary: Optional descriptive mode string for the current protection state.
